Koegaki 1.13.4

  • This release is for the Mac. Windows stays on 1.15.0 and Linux on 1.15.1.
  • On the Mac, Koegaki now updates itself in the background: new versions download quietly and install at a moment you are not dictating, and Koegaki comes back in the menu bar without opening its window, with one note on the pill saying it updated itself.
  • This update still arrives through the update window; from the next one on, updates install themselves.
